# Operational Note Template

## Title

Short workflow, support, or ownership topic.

## Why This Note Exists

Explain the operational need this note supports.

## Source of Truth

Link the route, file, doc, dashboard, or system that actually owns the behavior.

## When To Use This

State who uses the note or what event should cause someone to open it.

## What To Check or Do

- Key checks
- Safe actions
- Things to avoid

## Failure Signals or Safe-Failure Behavior

- What indicates trouble
- What should still degrade safely

## Revisit Trigger

State what change, incident, or date should cause this note to be reviewed.

## Do Not Include

- Full incident timelines
- Large setup guides already owned elsewhere
- Broad architecture decisions
